sentences.text: 1. The claimants in MVC.No.204/2016 on the file of Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Raichur (for short NC: 2023:KHC-K:4567-DB 'Tribunal'), have filed this appeal challenging the impugned judgment and award dated 25.09.2017 claiming for enhancement of compensation.

2. Though this matter has come up for hearing on 'Admission', with the consent of both the parties,
it is taken up for 'Final Disposal'.
3. For the sake of convenience, we refer the parties as per their rank before the Tribunal.

Smt.Rupa Devi And Anr vs Mohammed Hippagiri And Anr on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/178464215/
2 4.

entities.text: Smt.Rupa Devi And Anr vs Mohammed Hippagiri And Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It was the case of the claimants that, on 14.12.2015, the deceased Uppari Ramesh along with his friend Golla Narasimhalu @ Naraswimha were going on motorcycle bearing registration No.KA-36/X-2310; deceased Ramesh was rider of the motorcycle and Golla Narasimhalu was pillion rider.
On Raihur-Adoni Main Road, at Sunkeshwari bus stop they met with an accident due to rash and negligent driving of N.E.K.R.T.C. bus bearing No. KA-27/F-0593.
Due to accident Ramesh and Narasimhalu had sustained grievous injuries and while undergoing NC: 2023:KHC-K:4567-DB treatment, Ramesh succumbed to the injuries in RIMS Hospital, Ballari on 18.12.2015.
5. It was the further case of the petitioners that deceased was aged 20 years and working as Clerk in a private firm and earning Rs.10,000/- per month.
Petitioners were depending upon his earnings.
With these reasons, they prayed to award compensation of Rs.25.00 lakhs.
6. Respondent No.2-NEKRTC denied the averments in the claim petition.
It has contended that accident was taken place due to negligence of rider of the motorcycle and therefore prayed to dismiss the claim petition.
7. From the rival contentions of the parties, the Tribunal had framed necessary issues.
8. The Tribunal clubbed MVC Nos.204/2016, 205/2016 and 206/2016 and common judgment is passed.

Claimants in all the three petitions had examined PWs.1 to 4 and got marked Exs.P1 to P17.
Respondent examined RW1.
NC: 2023:KHC-K:4567-DB 9.

The Tribunal after hearing both the sides and appreciating evidence on record, awarded compensation as under:
For loss of dependency Rs.8,64,000/- For loss of consortium Rs.20,000/-
 For loss of love and Rs.20,000/-
 affection  For loss of estate Rs.25,000/-
 For transportation of dead Rs.15,000/-
 body and funeral  expenses  TOTAL Rs.9,44,000/-
The same is challenged by the claimants seeking enhancement.
10. We have heard the arguments of learned counsel for both sides.
11. The learned counsel for appellants has vehemently contended that the Tribunal has not considered the income of the deceased properly.

As per the case of the claimants, he was earning Rs.10,000/- per month by NC: 2023:KHC-K:4567-DB working as Clerk (Gumastha) and he was Smt.Rupa Devi And Anr vs Mohammed Hippagiri And Anr on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/178464215/
3 aged about 20 years.

entities.text: Smt.Rupa Devi And Anr vs Mohammed Hippagiri And Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Future prospects were not considered.
Compensation awarded under other heads are also meagre.
Therefore, prayed to enhance the amount of compensation.

12. The learned counsel for respondents has submitted that the Tribunal has considered all the facts properly and passed the impugned judgment and award and it does not call for any interference by this Court.

13. The following point emerges for our determination:
"Whether claimants are entitled for enhancement of the compensation?"
14.
The Tribunal has held that accident was taken place due to negligence of driver of bus and it is not challenged by the respondents.

15. The Tribunal on appreciation of material on record has held that age of the deceased as 20 years;
his earnings Rs.6,000/- per month; deducted 1/3 of it, towards NC: 2023:KHC-K:4567-DB personal expenses of the deceased; applied multiplier as '18' and awarded a compensation under the head loss of dependency.
16. Admittedly accident was taken place during the year 2015.
It is true that claimants were unable to prove earnings of the deceased.
Therefore, income of the deceased has to be calculated on basis of notional income taken while settling the matters in Lok Adalat.
Notional income of a victim of an accident during the year 2015 is taken as Rs.8,000/- per month.
There is no reasons as to why it shall not be applied to the present case.

Deceased died at the age of 20 years, therefore as held in the case of National Insurance Company Limited vs. Pranay Sethi and Others1 40% of income of deceased shall be added towards the 'Future Prospects'; 40% of Rs.8,000/- is Rs.3,200/- and total income will be 11,200/- per month.

entities.text: National Insurance Company Limited vs. Pranay Sethi and Others1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The deceased left behind him his wife and minor daughter.

Learned counsel for the respondent submits that the claimant in MVC 2017 ACJ 2700 NC:
2023:KHC-K:4567-DB No.205/2016 Smt. Sarojamma is mother of the deceased Ramesh.
She was not added as party in the claim petition of this case.
She should be considered for apportionment of the compensation and it does not change the amount of compensation to be awarded under the head loss of dependency.
Including mother, there are three dependents.

Therefore out of Rs.11,200/-,
1/3rd has to be deducted towards personal expenses of the deceased i.e., Rs.3,733/- per month.
The net income on which the claimants were dependent upon is Rs.7,467/- per month.
Considering the age of the deceased the Tribunal has rightly applied the multiplier of '18'.

Accordingly the amount of compensation to be awarded under the head 'loss of dependency' is Rs.16,12,872/- i.e., (Rs.7,467 x 12 x 18).
17.
The petitioners are widow, minor daughter and mother of the deceased.
They have lost love and affection of the deceased.
Therefore, each of the claimants are entitled for compensation for 'loss of love and affection' and 'consortium'.

As held in the case of PRANAY SETHI referred supra and also in the case of MAGMA GENERAL NC: 2023:KHC-K:4567-DB INSURANCE COMPANY LIMITED Vs. NANU RAM @ CHUHRU RAM2, each of the claimants are entitled for Rs.40,000/- towards 'loss of consortium'.

entities.text: MAGMA GENERAL NC: 2023:KHC-K:4567-DB INSURANCE COMPANY LIMITED Vs. NANU RAM @ CHUHRU RAM2
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In total they are entitled for a sum of Rs.1,20,000/- under the said head.

Smt.Rupa Devi And Anr vs Mohammed Hippagiri And Anr on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/178464215/
4 18.

entities.text: Smt.Rupa Devi And Anr vs Mohammed Hippagiri And Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It appears that the Tribunal has not considered the law laid down in the case of PRANAY SETHI referred to supra and awarded Rs.25,000/- towards loss of estate, which needs to be modified to Rs.15,000/-.
However, the amount of compensation awarded by the Tribunal towards 'funeral expenses' is just and proper, it does not call for any interference.

19. For the above said discussions, claimants are entitled for the following amount of compensation:
 Heads Award by the Award by this  Tribunal Court  Loss of dependency Rs.8,64,000/- 16,12,872/-
 Loss of consortium Rs.20,000/- 1,20,000/-
 Loss of love and affection Rs.20,000/- --
 Loss of estate Rs.25,000/- 15,000/-
 Funeral expenses Rs.15,000/- 15,000/-

TOTAL Rs.9,44,000/- 17,62,872/-
Claimants are entitled for enhancement of Rs.8,18,872/-.

In the impugned judgment and award the Tribunal has considered the share of the compensation to be awarded to mother of the deceased, who is not party in the present case and she was petitioner No.1 in connected MVC No.205/2016 and the Tribunal had apportioned the amount of compensation.
The same is kept intact.

21. For the above said reasons, we answer the above point partly in the affirmative and pass the following:
ORDER i. Appeal is partly allowed with costs.
 ii. The impugned judgment and award  passed by the Tribunal in MVC.No.204/2016 dated 25.09.2017 is modified.
iii.
Claimants are entitled for compensation of Rs.17,62,872/- as against Rs.9,44,000/- awarded by the Tribunal.
Claimants are entitled for enhancement of 8,18,872/- with interest @ 6% per annum from the date of petition on the - 11 - NC: 2023:KHC-K:4567-DB enhanced amount of compensation till its payment.
